notes: New: treatments in your own format. In Draft a treatment, pick From my headings and your copy's own sections become the slides; Claude or Codex picks a layout for each (big statement, text + image, storyboard, image grid, title + image) and you can rename, reorder, add or remove sections and save the structure as a format, like Music video or Commercial, for next time. Photo matching now looks at every photo in the project (not just the top 32), and you can re-run it for one page or every page with Find photos with AI. Template is now picked on the first screen. Also: + Add link on videos is back in Explore, and an open Instagram post never grabs from the feed behind it.
